item.title: A Decade of PHP Memory-Safety Bugs: Why Do the Same Failures Keep Returning?
item.description: A technical retrospective on a decade of PHP memory-safety research, crediting original discoverers and maintainers while examining failure atomicity, re-entrancy, bailout recovery, and cross-request ownership.

item.title: PHP Memory-Safety Research Notes (2016–2026): Discoverers, Root Causes, Fixes and Evidence
item.description: A source-based provenance map of PHP memory-safety findings from 2016 to 2026, crediting original researchers and maintainers while separating issue status, reproducibility, exploitability, and patch verification.
